# SEEDANCE 2.0 — reference for AI video-prompt generation (A.P.G)

> Injected into the LLM context when Target = Seedance. Output = ONE flowing paragraph
> of prose (no line breaks, no lists, no markdown), ready to paste into Seedance 2.0.

## Hard format rules
- Single flowing paragraph, max ~1800 characters.
- Total duration = the user's Timing value (cap 15s). Each shot 2–5s; shot durations sum to the total.
- Shot count = the user's "shots" value (3–7 sweet spot). Fast/energetic = more, shorter; contemplative = fewer, longer.
- Use "Cut to." (with the period) between shots — that's how Seedance breaks shots.
- Per shot specify all four, and VARY them across shots: shot size (wide/medium/close-up/macro/OTS), lens (24/35/50/85/135mm), angle (low/high/eye-level/Dutch/bird's-eye/worm's-eye/OTS), one movement verb (push in, pull out, track, orbit, pan, tilt, handheld, static, crane up/down, dolly).
- End with: `Photo real, natural framing. Audio: diegetic sound only — natural ambience, environmental foley, and subject-driven sound.`

## Engineering principles
- Subject anchoring: pin subject + 2–3 hard visual traits + location + time of day in the FIRST sentence (Seedance weighs first 20–30 words most). Otherwise it invents new characters per cut.
- One action per shot, one camera move per shot.
- Human-readable camera language (slow, smooth, gentle, steady, rapid). NEVER f-stops/ISO/fps.
- POSITIVE constraints only — Seedance has NO negative prompts. Say "stable picture, sharp clarity" not "no shaking".
- Character consistency: keep wardrobe/hair identical across shots; don't over-adjective.
- Photoreal anti-CG: describe the VISUAL RESULT, never the production technique. BANNED words: silicone, puppet, figurine, miniature, prosthetic, latex, foam, animatronic, CGI, CG, 3D render, VFX, stop-motion, claymation, doll, action figure, toy (unless the user explicitly wants that look).
- Reference image present: begin with `Using the uploaded image as a key visual reference,`.

## Style modes mapping (A.P.G Action/Weird/Beauty sliders)
- ACTION high -> 5–7 short shots (2–3s), 24/35mm, low/Dutch/worm's-eye, handheld/track/push/crane, impact verbs, momentum.
- WEIRD high -> oneiric/surreal + horror vocabulary: mix 24mm distortion & 135mm compression, Dutch/worm's-eye/high, slow creeping then sudden locks, shadows, partial reveals, impossible juxtapositions, liminal spaces.
- BEAUTY high -> product/auteur polish: 85/135mm, eye-level/low hero/bird's-eye, orbit/crane/slow dolly/smooth push, surface textures, reflections, material quality, clean compositions, macro detail.
- Blend the three by their slider weights.
